system.biography: An eel-cutter's child from the low levels, Joren won a university place on marks alone, fell out with a classmate over a chart neither would give back, and came home with a degree to cut reeds like everyone else. A season guiding surveyors through the back channels showed them the levels from outside. When the sluices wanted someone who could read a drawing they crossed to the dyke, stood by a neighbour through a bad winter, and at thirty walked down to the quay and signed for the patrol.

demo.cliff: an education is a career Item that runs a different set of rolls
teaches: A university has no tied career: its skills come from its own Service Skills table, and each pick says how many rows to take and at what level.

A pick's Level is the level the skill ends at; blank takes the row as printed, so one pick at level 0 and one at level 1 give one skill at each level, and neither a blank nor a 0 on the second pick will do.
Graduation raises what the education gave by one level (the raise block), grants EDU, and leaves a DM+1 to qualify for each named career, DM+1 more with honours.
Honours also leave a DM+2 on the commission roll before the first term of the first career after the school, held until that roll is made.
demo.trap: The university teaches from its own tables.service, so that table is filled in, unlike the cadet school's tied one; the other three tables, the ladders, assignments and benefits stay empty because an education never reads them. The fail arm is empty by decision: a graduate who fails keeps the skills and gains nothing else. The Harbour Patrol never commissions, so the honours commission DM stays pending when it is the first career entered. The eleven record fields below the tables stay empty, as on every template.

system.description: Bellweather's university on the hill above the old ferry quay, where the harbour's clerks, surveyors and pilots read for a few years before the patrol takes them. Invented for this pack, and no book's university.

A quarrel over a borrowed chart ends a friendship. Gain a Rival among the students.
Long nights in the reading room. Gain one level of Investigate.
A summer crewing a survey launch. Gain one level of Seafarer.
Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
You captain the university's rowing eight. Gain one level of Athletics.
A visiting harbourmaster takes an interest in you. Gain an Ally, and DM+1 on your graduation roll.

eventTable.text: Your paper is read aloud at the guildhall. SOC +1.
A season in the workshops between terms. Gain one level of Mechanic.
You settle a dispute between two shipping houses. Gain a Contact, and DM+2 on your graduation roll.

tray.note: A DM held for this school's graduation roll, spent by it.
A graduate's degree: DM+1 to qualify for the Harbour Patrol.

demo.cliff: an assignment change is a rule the template declares, or a world setting decides it
teaches: A civilian career with no commission: commission is false, both rank ladders are enlisted, and tables.officer stays absent.
Three assignments over two ladders: the reed cutters and the weir keepers climb the holding ladder, the dyke wardens their own.

assignmentChange: requalifyKeepRank lets the Traveller change assignment at the end of a term by passing this career's Qualification roll again: pass, and the rank is kept and read off the new assignment's ladder; fail, and nothing changes.
Event 9 holds DM+2 for this career's own Qualification roll, which a career already being served makes only to change assignment.
medicalBillsRow: independent, because a holder has no employer: the table pays nothing below 8 on two dice plus rank, half from 8 and three quarters from 12.
Event 2 rolls this career's Mishap table with ejects: stays, so the mishap is suffered and the holding kept; mishap 5 ejects only on a failed check, and mishap 6 only when the Traveller refuses.
Event 10 offers Demo — Harbour Patrol with qualification waived: careerMode offer leaves it on the tray, to be taken at a later qualification or declined.
Event 12 awards a promotion or an extra skill roll: two outcomes in oneOf mode, and the player picks one.
demo.trap: commission is false and tables.officer is absent: an officer ladder or table here would be read by nothing, and would promise a commission this career never offers. Event 9's DM is spent by an assignment change's re-qualification, or by entering this career again later, and by no other roll. pensionable is false for the reason the bills are independent: a holder has no employer to pay one. standingModifiers and tracks stay empty because the career prints neither, and the record fields below the tables stay empty, as on every template.

system.description: The smallholders of Bellweather's marsh: reed beds, eel weirs, and the dykes that keep the sea off both. A civilian career with no commission, whose three assignments a holder moves between by qualifying again, and whose injuries are billed on the independent column, since a holder has no employer. Invented for this pack, and no book's career.

bonus.text: An Ally on the fen council

other.text: A Contact at the eel market

eventTable.text: The spring flood breaks the lower dyke and takes a season's work with it. Roll on this career's Mishap table; whatever it says, the holding keeps you.

A buyer from the quay pays for a season's eels with a bad note. Make a Broker check (8+): succeed, and you get your price and DM+1 held for one Benefit roll from this career; fail, and the buyer becomes a Rival.

tray.note: The price recovered: DM+1 held for one Benefit roll from this career.

eventTable.text: A dry summer keeps you on the pumps day and night. Gain one level of Mechanic or Survival.
A murrain runs through the buffalo on the levels. Make an Animals check (7+): succeed, and the holders whose herds you saved become a Contact; fail, and the loss costs you one Benefit roll.
A survey team from the starport hires you to take them through the back channels. Gain one level of Navigation or Recon, and a Contact among the surveyors.
Life Event: roll on the shared Life Events table.
A neighbour's barn burns, and you raise a new one with them before the rains. Gain an Ally among the holders.
Your neighbours put their marks to a letter for you. DM+2 held for this career's next Qualification roll, the one a change of assignment makes.

tray.note: The neighbours' letter: DM+2 held for this career's next Qualification roll.

eventTable.text: The patrol's marsh station wants someone who knows every channel by name. Gain one level of Seafarer, and a standing offer of a place in Demo — Harbour Patrol, with no Qualification roll.
A harvest that fills every barn on the levels. Gain one extra Benefit roll.
The holders elect you reeve of the levels for a season. Take a promotion, or an extra roll on any of this career's skill tables.

mishapTable.text: A bank gives way under you in the dark. Roll on the Injury table.
Blight takes the reed beds two years running, and the holding is sold for its debts. One of your Benefit rolls goes with it.
A quarrel over water with the holding upstream ends before the water court, and you lose it. Gain an Enemy.
Marsh fever keeps you abed through a whole planting. END -1.
The dyke board marks your land for a new channel. Make an Advocate check (9+) before the water court: fail, and the land is taken.

The patrol finds smugglers' boats in your channels and asks you to name the holders who rent them. Name them, and you keep the holding with an Enemy among your neighbours; refuse, and the holding is taken.

demo.cliff: chargen has nothing to run against without one
teaches: One career Item carries the whole of a career: qualification, one rank ladder, one assignment with its survival and advancement checks, three skill tables, a benefit table, an event table and a mishap table.
Every row is a {text, mode, grants[]} triple — text is what the player reads, grants[] is what the screen applies, and mode: oneOf is what makes the player choose.

A tray entry on an event row is put aside for later: row 9's DM waits for the next qualification roll and row 11's automatic success for the next promotion roll, where row 12 awards the promotion outright.

An event row can throw its own check and make its effects wait on it: row 3's check is optional and its branches hold a DM or cost a Benefit roll, and row 8's is made on the better of two skills and raises the one used.
Row 6 stakes a Benefit roll on its check, and grantFirst gives the row's skill before the throw, so the throw is made with it.
medicalBillsRow names the employer's column on the Medical Bills table, which pays part of an injury's care.
standingModifiers[] is the career's own permanent DM, gated on a characteristic and scoped to one step.
demo.trap: The eleven fields below the tables — assignment, terms, rank, ladder, enlistedRank, gained, events, entryMode, exitMode, termLog, track — are the record half of this type, and they stay at their defaults on a template. The same Item type is both the career a Traveller may enter and the career a Traveller served; termLog is what tells the two apart.

system.description: Bellweather's harbour patrol: tide watch, boat inspection, and whatever comes out of the marsh. Invented for this pack, and no book's career.

eventTable.text: A hull comes apart in the channel. Roll on the Mishap table, but you are not ejected from this career.

A cargo you waved through was not what the manifest said. Gain a Rival on the quay. If you report it, make a Investigate check (8+): succeed, and DM+1 is held for your next Advancement roll; fail, and the report costs you one Benefit roll.

tray.note: The report pays off: DM+1 held for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: A winter of night watches. Gain one level of Vacc Suit or Athletics.
You pull a crew off a sinking launch. Make a Seafarer check (8+); success gains a Contact and a commendation.

tray.note: The commendation is a +2 held back for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: The harbour puts you through a course you did not ask for: gain one level of Mechanic. The instructors run a book on the final engine test; if you wish, stake one Benefit roll on a Mechanic check (8+): win, and gain one more; lose, and it is gone.
Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
You take an inspection nobody else would sign. Make a Investigate or Persuade check (8+): pass, and gain an extra Benefit roll. Either way, the skill you used gains a level.
A quiet word from the Harbourmaster. Gain an Ally, and a DM+1 held for your next Qualification roll.

tray.note: A tray entry outlives the term it was won in: this one waits for the next Qualification roll.

eventTable.text: You are moved to the marsh station and given a boat of your own. Gain one level of Seafarer and SOC +1.
A season with nothing to show for it, and a promotion board that noticed anyway: your next promotion roll passes without dice.

tray.note: The board's goodwill waits for one promotion roll, and passes it without dice.

eventTable.text: You bring in a smuggler half the sector wanted. Gain an automatic promotion.

mishapTable.text: A boat goes over on you. Roll on the Injury table and leave the patrol.
You are blamed for a sinking that was nobody's fault. Gain an Enemy and leave the patrol.
Dock fever, and a long winter in a bunk. Lose one level of Athletics and leave the patrol.
A bribe you did not take is reported as one you did. You keep your rank and lose the job.
The marsh station is closed and you with it. A Social check (8+) keeps you on the payroll.
You are injured pulling someone else out. Roll on the Injury table; you may stay on.

standingModifiers.note: A patroller known on the quay adds DM+1 to Benefit rolls from this career.

demo.cliff: a career record holds one assignment, so a change of course overwrites the one before it
teaches: Three records and one clock: the term number runs through the university and both careers, so the school's term brings the first ageing roll into the patrol's only term.
A new assignment is a Qualification roll inside decide. Passed, the Fen record keeps rank 1 and moves to the warden ladder, and the term closes as any other.
A Contact, a Rival and an Ally are each one contact Item written by an event row. provenance.career and provenance.term name the record and the term, and that term's log carries the same line.
demo.trap: Once the change passes, assignment, ladder and entryMode are overwritten, and entryMode reads assignmentChange on a career that was entered on a roll: only the line it wrote in term 2's log still says Reed Cutter. The three contacts are all named New Contact, because a row writes a relation and leaves the name to the player.
